direction.name: Clean UI
direction.description: Calm neutrals, precise spacing and clear interaction states.
layoutRules: Keep one primary action per screen.
Separate panels with borders before shadows.
direction.a11yRisk: Low-contrast neutrals and understated focus states can make a calm interface hard to navigate.

direction.name: Dark-First
direction.description: Dark surfaces with light used only for hierarchy and focus.
layoutRules: Use two dark surface levels, not five.
Reserve the lightest text for headings and active labels.
Keep one accent for selection and focus.
do: Use near-black surfaces instead of pure black.
Keep borders visible on every panel.
dont: Use pure white text at full weight everywhere.
Rely on color alone for errors.
direction.a11yRisk: Dark themes hide weak contrast in muted text, borders and disabled controls.

direction.name: Spatial
direction.description: Layered panels with depth, light and optional spatial motion.
layoutRules: Limit the scene to three depth planes.
Keep every action reachable in a flat 2D fallback.
Give text panels a solid, opaque surface.
dont: Put body text in a moving 3D layer.
Use motion as the only cue for hierarchy.
direction.a11yRisk: Depth and camera motion can cause discomfort and make focus and z-order unpredictable.
